shortDescription: Fetch information about Cloud Foundry service instance keys

options.name: api_endpoint
options.description: The endpoint URL of the Cloud Foundry API.

options.name: password
options.description: The password for authentication with the Cloud Foundry API.

options.name: service_instance_guid
options.description: The GUID of the Cloud Foundry service instance to fetch keys for. Either this or the service_instance_name parameter is required.

options.name: service_instance_name
options.description: The name of the Cloud Foundry service instance to fetch keys for. Either this or the service_instance_guid parameter is required.

options.name: username
options.description: The username for authentication with the Cloud Foundry API. This is SAP BTP user email address
